instruction: Enable natural scrolling for the touchpad so the content moves in the same direction as your fingers.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling natural scrolling for touchpad by setting org.gnome.desktop.peripherals.touchpad natural-scroll to true. Evaluator verifies the setting value using gsettings get command.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.peripherals.touchpad natural-scroll' to retrieve the current natural-scroll setting
Expected value 'true\n' is semantically correct - gsettings outputs 'true\n' when natural scrolling is enabled (includes newline character)
Metric 'exact_match' correctly compares the command output with the expected value using exact string comparison
Complete coverage - the evaluator checks the exact requirement: whether natural scrolling is enabled
Data flow is correct: getter extracts gsettings output → metric receives result and expected rules → compares 'true\n' == 'true\n'
No edge case issues - the newline character is properly handled in the expected value
